info.name: School Management API
info.description:
API collection for School Management System

Base URL: http://localhost:3000

Endpoints:
1. POST /addSchool - Add a new school
2. GET /listSchools - Get schools sorted by distance

variable.description: Change this to your hosted URL when deployed

request.description: Check if the API server is running

Adds a new school to the database.

**Required fields:**
- name (string, non-empty)
- address (string, non-empty)
- latitude (float, -90 to 90)
- longitude (float, -180 to 180)

response.name: 201 - School Added Successfully
400 - Validation Error

request.description: Tests validation — should return 400 with error messages

Fetches all schools and sorts them by distance from the given coordinates using the Haversine formula.

**Required query params:**
- latitude (float)
- longitude (float)

response.name: 200 - Schools List
400 - Missing Parameters

request.description: Tests validation — should return 400 when lat/lng are missing
